en: Color postcard showing a large concrete arch dam and blue reservoir in a rocky mountain gorge. At right is a modernist observation tower with switch‑back stairs and a person in an orange top on a balcony. Clear blue sky. Reverse has a multilingual caption identifying the hydropower station on the Argeș River, address lines in Romanian, price in lei, photo credit to Al. Florescu, and publisher Editura Meridiane.
